text: Hino e jeyaa e yurmeende Seniiɗo On, ko tawi kon O waɗiranii on, onon yimɓe ɓen, jemma on ñiɓɓituɗo; fii no deeƴiron e makko, ɓaawo ronkere golle ñalorma ɗen, O waɗirani on ñalorma on, ndayginɗo; fii no ɗaɓɓiron e makko arsike, e no yettiron neemaaji Alla ɗin e dow mooɗon, belajo'o, on yeddataa ɗi.
